objective_scope: minimize a 10000-unit penalty per unrouted commodity plus unit-edge and vertical-step proxy costs; bend penalties are excluded from optimization
physical_cost_reporting: recomputed after solving with the full route-cost function; descriptive only
independent_route_validation: all returned paths passed the shared route validator during generation
interpretation: The 30-second diagnostic used a longer budget than heuristic holdout methods and cannot establish a runtime-matched advantage. Optimality applies to the 10000-penalty weighted proxy objective, not a guaranteed lexicographic maximum of routed commodities or the paper's full bend-penalized physical objective. A time-limit result is not an infeasibility proof.
